scope: Offline MSM8998 v2/v2.1 Xiaomi sagit CPRh calibration and controller initialization

basis: xiaomi-sagit-msm8998-v2-mtp.dts includes msm8998-v2.dtsi and sagit board overlay; board-id <30 0>
xiaomi-sagit-msm8998-v2.1-mtp.dts includes msm8998-v2.1.dtsi and same board overlay
xiaomi-msm8998-v2.1.dtsi inherits v2 and changes msm-id, without CPRh or OSM table overrides
sagit board overlay has no APC CPRh or clock_cpu table override
board_identity.unknown_identity_policy: Reject, never reuse another board's voltage data

efuse.speed_bin: row38[31:29], only 0..3 have fixed sagit tables
efuse.partial_binning: row100[45]; use highest active corner voltage/quotient/RO at all frequencies
efuse.invalid_policy: Reject absent or all-ones target quotients, unsupported speed bins, quotient offset underflow and out-of-range register encodings

calibration_pipeline: Select fixed sagit v2 DTS per-fuse-combo and per-speed-bin arrays.
Decode per-cluster four signed-magnitude 6-bit initial-voltage fuses, RO selects, target quotients and split-row quotient offsets.
Calculate fused voltage from v2 reference voltages and 10 mV signed steps; add per-fuse board adjustment and enforce monotonicity.
Interpolate voltage at corner frequencies using the vendor integer division direction; add per-corner board adjustment and enforce monotonicity.
Round up to 4 mV PMIC setpoints, clip to floor/ceiling, adjust APM 800 mV and MEM-ACC 852 mV crossings.
Use adjusted open-loop voltage as ceiling, enforce maximum floor range and monotonic floors.
Apply per-RO quotient scaling to per-fuse and per-corner voltage adjustments, interpolate quotients with RO changes and offset*5, enforce monotonic quotients only across equal ROs.
Apply force-highest partial-binning override while preserving each frequency.
Append inactive open-loop APM 880 mV and MEM-ACC 852 mV crossover corners.
Encode per-RO minimum target quotient, active RO mask, voltage steps and ceil(delta quotient/4) corner words.
Generate all 40 OSM rows from the fixed speed-bin source; voltage field uses final CPR ceiling, retain turbo rows which share virtual corners but use different frequencies.

controller_initialization.clock_reference: gcc-msm8998.c:995-1013,2214-2229; GCC root CMD0x48044 and branch0x48008

fields.sensor_owner: all thread0; 6 sensors power, 9 sensors performance

controller_initialization.ordering: Enable/verify clocks; inspect both OSM banks and both CPRh banks; apply and read back both CPRh plans; program OSM; enable OSM last.
controller_initialization.firmware_live_cpr_policy: Default API reuses a running loop only on an exact register match. Explicit Ownership requires post-EBS, both OSM banks disabled, verified secure OSM and 19.2MHz clock; under those conditions apply clears LOOP_EN and polls idle up to 5ms before programming. This follows init_ctrl's loop-disable transition with an added bounded idle check using the vendor wait/status convention.
controller_initialization.failure_policy: Every programmed field is read back; a programming failure disables the CPR loop and OSM interface. Bridge must disable OSM before CPRh rollback.

secure_firmware_boundary.osm_enable_zero: Means the HLOS enable step did not complete; alone it does not prove the protected sequencer was never initialized.
secure_firmware_boundary.v2: Qualcomm rejects qcom,osm-no-tz for v2; protected sequencer, PMIC/SAW/SPM and related secure initialization must be verified from the running firmware.
secure_firmware_boundary.v1: The no-TZ HLOS sequence path has a distinct bring-up responsibility and cannot be assumed compatible with v2.
secure_firmware_boundary.production_boundary: CPRhCalibration and CPRhInitialization never write protected OSM sequencer or guessed PMIC state; OSM firmware/secure IO integration owns secure admission and allowed SCM writes.

offline_validation.table_source_and_regeneration_check: python3 scripts/generate-cprh-tables.py --check; verifies all recorded local source hashes and exact generated tables
offline_validation.oracle: Unmodified function bodies extracted from the pinned vendor C, compiled as a separate C object with host-only allocation and selected-property shims
coverage: all signed voltage fuse encodings across deterministic samples
offline_validation.controller: tests/cprh_initialization_test.cpp; expected registers/order, readback, idempotence, busy/live mismatch rejection, each read/write failure and malformed plan rejection
offline_validation.hardware_validation: Not performed; tests do not establish that the device's protected firmware path is ready.
